source_clause: Clause 1.1 - Scope of Packaged Drinking Water
requirement_text_original: This standard prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking water other than packaged natural mineral water intended for direct human consumption.
requirement_text_normalized: Scope conformity prescribes requirements Within scope N/A tested per Visual and Sensory.
subject: Scope of Packaged Drinking Water
condition: All sealed, packaged potable water containers excluding natural mineral water.

requirement_text_original: The total dissolved solids (TDS) of packaged drinking water shall not exceed 500 mg/l when tested in accordance with IS 3025 (Part 16).
requirement_text_normalized: Total Dissolved Solids shall not exceed <= 500 mg/l tested per IS 3025 (Part 16).
subject: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS)
condition: Finished water sample at 27 deg C.

requirement_text_original: Escherichia coli and coliform bacteria shall be absent in any 250 ml sample when tested according to IS 15185.
requirement_text_normalized: E. coli count shall be absent 0 CFU/250ml tested per IS 15185.
subject: Microbiological Requirements
condition: Any retail or production container.

requirement_text_original: Each container shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the Standard Mark (ISI mark), batch number, date of manufacture, best before date, and net volume.
requirement_text_normalized: Mandatory markings shall be clearly and indelibly marked All present Boolean tested per Visual inspection per Clause 7.
subject: Marking Requirements
condition: Container label or embossed body.

requirement_text_original: This standard specifies requirements for stainless steel vacuum flasks, bottles, and insulated containers designed to hold hot or cold beverages.
requirement_text_normalized: Scope specifies requirements 300 - 2500 ml tested per Visual and Dimensional per Section 1.
subject: Scope
condition: Double-walled vacuum insulated containers from 300 ml to 2500 ml.

requirement_text_original: The inner body in contact with food or beverages shall be fabricated from Austenitic stainless steel Grade SS 304 conforming to IS 6911.
requirement_text_normalized: Chromium and Nickel content shall be fabricated Cr >= 17.5%, Ni >= 8.0% % wt tested per Spectrometry / Chemical analysis per IS 228.
subject: Material of Construction
condition: All surfaces contacting stored beverage.

requirement_text_original: When filled with boiling water at 95 deg C and kept at room temperature (27 deg C), the water temperature shall not drop below 60 deg C after 6 hours (for flasks <= 1L) or 65 deg C (for flasks > 1L).
requirement_text_normalized: Water temperature after 6h shall not drop below >= 60 deg C tested per Calibrated Thermocouple test per Clause 5.2.
subject: Thermal Insulation Performance
condition: Ambient 27 +/- 2 deg C.

requirement_text_original: The flask filled to nominal capacity shall withstand a free fall from a height of 1.0 m onto a hardwood block without leakage or loss of thermal insulation.
requirement_text_normalized: Leakage and insulation retention shall withstand No leakage, vacuum intact Boolean tested per Free drop from 1.0 m per Clause 7.1.
subject: Drop and Impact Test
condition: Filled to nominal capacity with water at 20 deg C.
test_method: Free drop from 1.0 m per Clause 7.1

requirement_text_original: This standard specifies requirements for domestic pressure cookers having nominal capacities up to and including 22 litres.
requirement_text_normalized: Nominal capacity specifies requirements <= 22 litres tested per Capacity determination per Clause 3.
subject: Scope of Pressure Cookers
condition: Domestic cookware <= 22 litres.

source_clause: Clause 4.1 - Materials of Body and Lid
requirement_text_original: The cooker body and lid shall be manufactured from aluminium alloy conforming to IS 21, or stainless steel conforming to IS 6911.
requirement_text_normalized: Material grade shall be manufactured IS 21 / IS 6911 Composition tested per Chemical analysis per IS 504 / IS 228.
subject: Materials of Body and Lid
condition: Body shell and lid.

source_clause: Clause 5.4 - Operating Pressure and Weight Valve
requirement_text_original: The pressure cooker shall operate smoothly at an operating pressure between 0.9 kgf/cm2 and 1.1 kgf/cm2 with automatic pressure release.
requirement_text_normalized: Operating pressure shall operate smoothly 0.9 to 1.1 kgf/cm2 tested per Manometer pressure testing per Clause 5.4.
subject: Operating Pressure and Weight Valve
condition: Cooker assembled with standard weight valve.

requirement_text_original: The pressure cooker shall withstand hydrostatic pressure of not less than 3 times the operating pressure (minimum 3.0 kgf/cm2) without rupture or catastrophic leakage.
requirement_text_normalized: Burst pressure shall withstand >= 3.0 kgf/cm2 tested per Hydrostatic pressure test rig per Clause 6.2.
subject: Hydraulic Burst Pressure Test
condition: Safety valves plugged, hydrostatic pressure applied.
test_method: Hydrostatic pressure test rig per Clause 6.2

requirement_text_original: Live parts shall not be accessible to standard test finger per IEC 61032 under all normal operating conditions.
requirement_text_normalized: Accessibility of live parts shall not be accessible Inaccessible Boolean tested per Test Probe B per IS 14003.
subject: Protection Against Electric Shock
condition: Appliance fully assembled and ungrounded during probe check.

source_clause: Clause 13.2 - Leakage Current and Dielectric Strength
requirement_text_original: The leakage current of the appliance at operating temperature shall not exceed 0.75 mA.
requirement_text_normalized: Leakage current shall not exceed <= 0.75 mA tested per Leakage current meter per Clause 13.
subject: Leakage Current and Dielectric Strength
condition: Operating at 1.15 times rated input power.

source_clause: Clause 2.1.1 - Protection in Operator Access Areas
requirement_text_original: Operator access areas shall be designed so that bare parts operating at hazardous voltage (SELV limit > 42.4V peak or 60V DC) are not touchable.
requirement_text_normalized: SELV barrier integrity shall be designed Protected Boolean tested per Jointed test finger probe per Clause 2.1.1.1.
subject: Protection in Operator Access Areas
condition: IT equipment energized at 230V AC.
test_method: Jointed test finger probe per Clause 2.1.1.1

requirement_text_original: Reinforced insulation between primary circuits and accessible parts shall withstand 3000 V r.m.s. AC for 60 seconds without breakdown.
requirement_text_normalized: Withstand voltage shall withstand >= 3000 V r.m.s. tested per Dielectric withstand tester per Clause 5.2.2.
subject: Electric Strength (High Voltage Withstand)
condition: Primary to secondary insulation barrier.

source_clause: Clause 4.1 - Small Parts for Children Under 36 Months
requirement_text_original: Toys intended for children under 36 months, and removable components thereof, shall not fit entirely within the small parts cylinder (diameter 31.7 mm).
requirement_text_normalized: Small part dimension fit shall not fit entirely Does not fit Boolean tested per Small parts cylinder test per Clause 5.2.
subject: Small Parts for Children Under 36 Months
condition: Toys intended for age < 36 months.
test_method: Small parts cylinder test per Clause 5.2

requirement_text_original: The peak acceleration imparted to the headform during impact onto flat and hemispherical steel anvils from a height of 2.8 m shall not exceed 300 g.
requirement_text_normalized: Headform peak acceleration shall not exceed <= 300 g tested per Guided drop assembly per Clause 7.2.
subject: Impact Attenuation Test
condition: Ambient, cold (-10 deg C), and wet conditioned helmets.

requirement_text_original: For grade Fe 500D, the 0.2 percent proof stress shall not be less than 500.0 N/mm2.
requirement_text_normalized: 0.2% Proof Stress shall not be less than >= 500.0 N/mm2 tested per Tensile testing machine per IS 1608.
subject: 0.2% Proof Stress / Yield Strength
condition: Batch test specimen from finished rebar.

requirement_text_original: The average compressive strength of at least three mortar cubes at 28 days (672 +/- 4 h) shall not be less than 43.0 MPa.
requirement_text_normalized: 28-day compressive strength shall not be less than >= 43.0 MPa tested per Compression testing machine per IS 4031 (Part 6).
subject: 28-Day Compressive Strength
condition: Standard mortar cubes (1:3 cement:standard sand).
